# Relocations from single statements, as whole objects against llvm-mc and
# as relocations against GNU as. `foo` is undefined unless a case defines it.
call foo
call foo+4
call foo-1
jmp foo
jmp foo+0x10
je foo
movl $0, foo(%rip)
movw $1, foo(%rip)
movb $2, foo(%rip)
movq $3, foo(%rip)
leaq foo(%rip), %rax
leaq foo+8(%rip), %rax
movabsq $foo, %rax
movabsq $foo+16, %rax
movl $foo, %eax
.quad foo
.quad foo+9
.long foo
.long foo+8
.long foo-4
.rva foo
.rva foo+12
.rva foo, foo+4
.secrel32 foo
.secrel32 foo+2
.secidx foo
.long foo@IMGREL
.long foo@IMGREL+6
.long foo - .
.long foo + 3 - .
.data; .long foo - .
.text; .globl foo; foo: ret; call foo
.text; foo: ret; call foo; jmp foo
.text; .globl foo; foo: ret; .quad foo; .long foo
.data; foo: .long 0; .long foo; .quad foo+2
.text; call bar; .data; bar: .long 1
.text; call bar; .data; .globl bar; bar: .long 1
.data; .rva bar; .text; bar: ret
.data; .long bar - .; .text; bar: ret
.text; nop; nop; .long foo
